name: Gilt market
summary: Gilt yields stay elevated after the Bank of England's 5 Nov rate rise, with bets on a December move; UK CPI due 18 Nov
state: The Bank of England raised Bank Rate on 5 Nov, its first rise in three years, and warned inflation would near 5%; gilt yields rose and traders increased bets on a December rise (CNBC; Bloomberg, 5 Nov). The 10-year gilt yield was near 5.14% on 11 Nov, 30bp lower over a month, inside the 40bp line (TokenPost). Yields remain at elevated levels ahead of UK inflation data on 18 Nov, so Watch is kept.
for_you: Gilt yields feed into fixed mortgage rates; lenders tend to reprice deals within weeks of sustained moves.
rubric_hit: Yields elevated after BoE rise; 10y 1m move < 40bp = Watch kept

sources.title: CNBC — Bank of England hikes interest rate, warns inflation will near 5%
Bloomberg — BoE rate-hike odds rise as markets price December move
TokenPost — UK 10-year gilt yield falls 30 basis points over past month

why: Gilt yields set UK mortgage rates and the government's borrowing costs; the 2022 LDI crisis showed how fast it can break.
drivers: Fiscal credibility, BoE policy, inflation, global bond moves, pension-fund flows.

rubric.alert: BoE intervention, or 10y moved > 75bp in a month.
rubric.watch: 30y gilt at multi-decade highs, or 10y moved 40–75bp in a month, or a weak auction.
rubric.normal: 10y gilt moved < 40bp in a month and auctions orderly.
